note: Lafourche Parish: the parish planning page says unincorporated areas have no zoning regulations. No parish zoning layer exists on the parish GIS hub or ArcGIS Online. The largest city, Thibodaux, publishes its zoning map only as a static PDF (Zoning Map.pdf, revised 2024), with no queryable service. Other towns (Lockport, Larose, Golden Meadow) showed no zoning GIS in search.
